svg.text: Low-fidelity layout. Grey boxes are content, the purple button is the one primary action, the dashed box is where the result appears.
LAPTOP (1020 px and wider): two columns
other tabs: drop zone / mic button / file
CHECKED AGAINST TRUSTED SOURCES SUCH AS
What the answers mean (2 columns on tablet)
1 Header: logo, page links, language, settings (text size, theme, install), WhatsApp button
2 Hero copy: promise, 3 trust points, example answer (laptop only)
3 Checker: four tabs (Message, Screenshot, Voice, PDF), one big Check it button, example chips
4 Result: verdict banner, claim cards with sources, warning, Listen / Share / Copy / Check another, feedback
5 Trusted-source strip (phone: trust chips just under the checker)
6 How it works, 3 steps (3 columns on laptop, stacked on phone)
8 WhatsApp card with QR code and button 9 FAQ, 4 questions 10 Footer: privacy, disclaimer
Breakpoints: 1020+ two columns | 920+ page links in header | 800+ three-column steps | 640+ tabs show icon and label side by side | under 420 compact tabs
